errors.evidence: The plotted points are approximately 9.9, 6.9, 5.6, 3.1, and 2.8 respectively, so the description overstates several early values.
The later points are all slightly lower than stated; the curve drops to around 0.1–0.2 by the final factors, not 0.3 at factor 49.
